text: Netizens have become curious about Kirk Cousins’ net worth in 2025 . Over the years, the 36-year-old has received several honors and awards for his contributions to football. As a result, fans are wondering about how he has built his fortune throughout his career. Without further ado, here’s what you need to know about Cousins’ current net worth and the sources of his income. Kirk Cousins has an estimated net worth of $140 million in 2025 . Cousin’s net worth in 2025 consists of earnings from his career as a professional football player. Kirk Cousins is most famous for serving as a quarterback for the NFL’s Atlanta Falcons. He has also played for the Washington Redskins and Minnesota Vikings. Cousins’ notable career highlights include the 2023 Bart Starr Award and being named to the second-team all-Big Ten in 2011. Kirk Cousins is a professional football player. Most recently, Cousins shared that he felt “misled” by the Atlanta Falcons picking Michael Penix Jr. after signing him as a free agent. (via Fox 5 Atlanta ) “If I had the information around free agency, it certainly would’ve affected my decision. I had no reason to leave Minnesota with how much we loved it there if both teams are going to be drafting a quarterback high,” he shared on Netflix’s recent docuseries Quarterback. Kirk Cousins earns money from his professional football career. Kirk Cousins first played college football for Michigan State Spartans before being drafted by the Washington Redskins for the fourth round of their 2012 NFL draft. With 1500 attempts, he ended up ranking all-time sixth in completion percentage. Cousins also secured 11th place in the NFL’s all-time regular season career passer rating. His first three seasons were with the Washington Redskins, where he helped shepherd the team to a division title. While with the team, Cousins set several records, eventually getting named to the 2017 Pro Bowl. Kirk Cousins later left the Redskins after being unable to agree on a long-term deal with them and signed with the Minnesota Vikings in 2018 as a free agent. In his six seasons with the Vikings, he secured three Pro Bowl selections. Moreover, Cousins later signed with the Atlanta Falcons in 2024. His salaries and earnings from his professional football career have majorly contributed to his net worth.
